name: Warren County Parks and Recreation Mah Jongg Club
description: Weekly senior-friendly Mah Jongg club organized by Deb Jones with Warren County Parks and Recreation since 2014. Northern Virginia Daily (June 11, 2026): the club uses the American/League card; players bring their own card. Evidence is a news article, not the organizer's own page.
address: Warren County Community Center, Villa Avenue, Front Royal, VA
schedule: Tuesdays 10 a.m.-noon; $3 per day or $8 monthly (per news article)
